embedded_exact_byte_custody: canonical unpadded base64url, nonempty decoded bytes, lowercase sha256 binding; decoded bytes pass through without JSON reserialization
request_digest: sha256 of finite ensure_ascii canonical JSON over every request field except request_digest
intent_digest: sha256 of finite ensure_ascii canonical JSON over the prepared intent excluding intent_digest
prepare_create_separation: prepare opens no installation and performs zero writes, locks, ledgers, issues, or manifests; create rebuilds from the original packet
confirmation_requirement: exact rebuilt intent digest before installation open and producer invocation
producer_passthrough: five decoded immutable bytes values, requested bounds, and validity pass to one producer call without normalization
consumer_compatibility: existing production chat resource context owner loads the actuator-created bundle and its one unspent allocation
restart_conservation_inheritance: consumer reload observes the same durable allocation and reduced remaining entitlement without actuator or producer invocation
selected_next_slice: production custody and publication of genuine provisioning request inputs
